concept.hr: Administrator radi s filtriranim tokenom dok ne podigne ovlasti
concept.en: Admins run with a filtered token until elevated

summary.hr: Ana je administratorica, a Explorer ipak ne smije pisati u Program Files: SID Administrators samo za zabranu. Potvrda, puni token, nasljeđivanje.
summary.en: ana is an administrator, yet Explorer cannot write to Program Files: Administrators is deny-only. Consent, the full token, inheritance.
